title: Nurse says the Wright Patterson craft came from Aztec

tellings.quote: That's how they found out it came from Aztec. She claimed it came from Aztec

plain: A nurse is said to have claimed that a crashed craft held at Wright Patterson, an Air Force base in Dayton, Ohio, came from Aztec, a town in New Mexico where a saucer is said to have come down. Scott Ramsey, who researches the Aztec crash, repeats what the nurse said, and says this is how they "found out it came from Aztec." If true, it would link the Aztec crash to the military.
